# NABLA (Crunch)

JAX/Flax library imported by ATHENA's PINN codes (`Crunch.Models.layers`, `Crunch.Auxiliary.metrics`, ...).
Vendored from github.com/jdtoscano94/NABLA-SciML (commit 1b2acd0 plus the working-tree files the runs used, copied 2026-11-06).
Installed into the release container with `pip install third_party/NABLA`.
